services.desc: When it comes to community venues in Vancouver, what makes the Roundhouse so unique is that it’s a combination of arts centre, recreation facility, and historic landmark. From rooms for small meetings and a multi-purpose gym, to the black-box theatre and Turntable Plaza, the Roundhouse offers versatile space for a multitude of events, including weddings, gallery exhibitions, and arts festivals-for 3 to 300 people. There are many rate categories for room rentals at the Roundhouse depending on the nature of the event. blurb: The Engine 374 Pavilion is run in partnership with the West Coast Rail Association (WCRA), the Vancouver Park Board, and the Roundhouse Community Arts and Recreation Association. The pavilion is staffed by volunteers through WCRA several hours per day, seven days per week year-round (depending on volunteer availability).
